title: observability: token-level metrics, tracing & logging dashboard + alert tuning
description: Motivation: improve signal for token-level cost/latency regressions and KV cache effectiveness across serving tiers. This PR adds new metrics, tracing spans and logging fields; updates Grafana dashboards with token-level cost/latency breakdown panels; and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving sensitivity to regressions. Scope: metric instrumentation (runtime), trace sampling tweaks, logging schema changes, dashboard JSON, and alert rules. Work items: ENG-5123 (token-level cost/latency telemetry), ENG-5124 (kv cache hit metrics + tracing), PM-221 (dashboard UX and alert noise). Changes included: new metrics (redwood.inference.token_latency_ms, redwood.inference.token_cost_units, redwood.inference.kv_cache_hit_rate), additional tags (model, route_id, deployment_tier), KV-specific spans for cache lookup/insert with timing, structured logs include token_count and billing_units, Grafana dashboard JSON with new panels for per-route token cost breakdown and 50/95/99 latency percentiles, Alerting: adjusted SLO alerts to use 99th percentile and added composite alert for cost spikes vs traffic. Testing: local integration, end-to-end on staging, and manual verification of dashboards. Checklist: - [x] Instrument metrics and tracing spans in runtime - [x] Add structured log fields and migration note - [x] Create dashboard panels and add to infra repo - [x] Tune alerts and add runbook links - [x] Add unit tests for new metric labels Deployment notes: deploy runtime + sidecar config bump together; dashboard changes live in Grafana provisioning; alerts will be staged to staging first. Rollout plan: staged on dedicated clusters for 24h, monitor token-level cost deltas, then release to hosted API.
